newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: FORECAST - DUTCH COMPANY RESULTS DUE NOV 11.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - DUTCH COMPANY RESULTS DUE NOV 11.

text.p: Analysts' estimates of Dutch company results for week beginning Monday, Nov 11 include:
Profit figures are net profits before extraordinary items and in millions of guilders unless otherwise stated.
Securities houses surveyed included: Amstgeld, Bangert Pontier, BZW, Delta Lloyd Bank, Generale Bank, Gilissen, ING, Kempen & Co, Labouchere, Rabo/IRIS, NIB Strating, Suez and Wesselius.
NOTE - Banks and brokers interested in contributing to Reuters surveys can contact the Amsterdam newsroom on +31-20-504-5000 or fax their forecasts to +31-20-504 5040.
For the week starting Nov 18 we are collecting Q3 result forecasts for Heidemij and ING and 1995/1996 results for CSM.
